messages:
Maya Patel: noticing AZ-3 GPU pool bootstrap failing — ENI attach errors, ephemeral IPs depleted on subnet-az3-gpu. Rolling back current nodegroup. Anyone seen this pattern before?
Sam Chen: seeing same in the kubelet logs: 'AttachNetworkInterface: InsufficientAssignedAddresses' on all new worker boots.
Liam O'Neill: net metrics show public-ip utilization 98% for subnet-az3-gpu-ephemeral. Autoscaler spiked and tried to create more nodes than the subnet can allocate.
Nora Gomez: NetOps — can you confirm if provider ran out of ephemeral SNAT ports or IPs? @NetOps-Bot?
NetOps-Bot: Querying quotas... result: available_ips=12, required_ips=48 for requested nodecount=24; elastic_ip_pool=0.
Maya Patel: TF apply attempted node_count=24, expected 12. I think a misconfig in terraform var 'gpu_pool_scale' defaulted to 2x staging. Oops.
Sam Chen: logs snippet:
```text
kubelet[2026-03-18T14:03:12Z]: failed to attach ENI: InsufficientAssignedAddresses: Not enough IPs
pod kube-system/cni-init CrashLoopBackOff
```
Liam O'Neill: Quick mitigation: scaling down ASG to safe_count=12 and re-running bootstrap. I'll attempt graceful cordon/drain of partially created nodes.
Nora Gomez: Requesting NetOps to raise allocated IPs for subnet-az3 by +64, plus temporary SNAT pool increase. Ticket created #NET-4572.
NetOps-Bot: Ticket #NET-4572 created; ETA 2h for IP pool expansion in AZ-3 (provider constraints). If urgent, can carve from spare subnet in AZ-2.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for nodegroup gpu-az3-20260318 by maya — status: in_progress
Maya Patel: If expansion will take 2h, plan B: manual reprovision nodes into AZ-2 or set nodeAffinity to prefer AZ-2 for this rollout. Thoughts?
Liam O'Neill: I can re-run provisioning with region_az_override=az2 for this deploy. But cluster-autoscaler config must be adjusted to avoid double-counting. I'll patch and test on a single canary node first.
Sam Chen: we should update the runbook: validate terraform var ranges and fail when desired_count > subnet.available_ips. Add a preflight hook that checks subnet capacity.
Maya Patel: agree. Adding preflight check ticket #INFRA-2156 — will include ip_count_check, asg_expected_vs_subnet_capacity, and kubelet ENI error grep.
oncall: @Maya @Liam I want to be on the handoff — I'll monitor node readiness and evict pods if needed. DM me when you start.
Nora Gomez: after rollback/scale-down confirm the kube-proxy and cni daemonsets recovered. If any DaemonSet stuck, run `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart ds/cni-plugin`.
Maya Patel: performed scale-down to 12, rollback completed. Observed CNI crashloops reduced to zero. Next step: coordinate patch for tf var and preflight, then re-provision to az2.
Liam O'Neill: starting a canary reprovision to AZ-2 with desired_count=12. Will post logs. :rocket:
NetOps-Bot: net quota expansion completed earlier than ETA. Reserved +64 IPs to subnet-az3. Flagging for cleanup after rollout.
Sam Chen: canary passed on az2. No ENI errors. Good to go to reattempt az3 once tf fix merged.
Maya Patel: merging fix and adding preflight to CI. Thank you all. Creating postmortem stub: INFRA-PM-20260318. Assigning owners: Maya/Sam/Liam/Nora.
oncall: closing loop — handoff done. If anyone wants to follow up I'll add notes to the runbook.
